verdict.rationale: Tavily's SDK explicitly exposes get_search_context, which returns 'a context string that you can feed directly into your RAG Application,' and qna_search, described as giving 'accurate and concise answers ... Perfect for usage by LLMs!' — both purpose-built to size/rank content for LLM consumption in RAG pipelines. Missing for 10: no documented details on token/size limits or ranking algorithm internals, and no independent (non-vendor) benchmark confirming RAG effectiveness.
